name: PR86 alternative payment diagnostic: cannot-assign governor, official accounting, 21 real AI turns

steps.code: if Game.GetLocalPlayer()~=0 or not Players[0]:IsHuman() or UI.IsGameCoreBusy() then error('baseline is not ready for human operations') end; local n=0; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do n=n+1 end; if n~=22 then error('baseline needs the same 22 factions') end; return 'baseline has 22 factions and idle game core'

local count=0; for row in GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas() do if GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType] then error('persona remains an engine candidate: '..row.LeaderType) end; count=count+1 end; if count~=22 then error('missing persona definitions') end; local r=GameInfo.Governors['GOVERNOR_JAC_TITLE_PROXY']; if not r or not GameInfo.GovernorsCannotAssign[r.GovernorType].CannotAssign then error('payment governor is assignable') end; return '22 personas excluded from native candidates; payment governor cannot be assigned'

local ai=0; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local gs=p:GetGovernors(); local culture=p:GetCulture(); local earned=0; for row in GameInfo.JAC_PersonaTitleCivics() do if earned<3 then local c=GameInfo.Civics[row.CivicType]; if not culture:HasCivic(c.Index) then local before=gs:GetGovernorPoints(); culture:SetCulturalProgress(c.Index,culture:GetCultureCost(c.Index)); if gs:GetGovernorPoints()~=before+1 then error('civic must grant one official title') end; earned=earned+1 end end end; if earned~=3 or gs:GetGovernorPoints()-gs:GetGovernorPointsSpent()<3 then error('three title budget missing') end; Game:SetProperty('JAC_PROXY_TOTAL_'..p:GetID(),gs:GetGovernorPoints()); Game:SetProperty('JAC_PROXY_SPENT_'..p:GetID(),gs:GetGovernorPointsSpent()); if not p:IsHuman() then ai=ai+1 end end; if ai~=21 then error('21 AI houses required') end; return 'all 22 players earned three official titles'

local n=0; local def=GameInfo.Governors['GOVERNOR_JAC_TITLE_PROXY']; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do if not p:IsHuman() then n=n+1; local gs=p:GetGovernors(); if gs:HasGovernor(def.Hash) or gs:GetGovernorPointsSpent()~=Game:GetProperty('JAC_PROXY_SPENT_'..p:GetID()) then error('native AI spent a title on the payment proxy: '..p:GetID()) end; if gs:GetGovernorPoints()-gs:GetGovernorPointsSpent()<3 then error('AI title budget vanished') end end end; if n~=21 then error('AI house inventory changed') end; return '21 AI native turns completed without proxy appointment or spending'

local gs=Players[0]:GetGovernors(); local def=GameInfo.Governors['GOVERNOR_JAC_TITLE_PROXY']; if not gs:CanAppointGovernor(def.Hash) then error('legitimate native payment appointment denied') end; UI.RequestPlayerOperation(0,PlayerOperations.APPOINT_GOVERNOR,{[PlayerOperations.PARAM_GOVERNOR_TYPE]=def.Index}); return 'requested official one-title payment'

local gs=Players[0]:GetGovernors(); if gs:GetGovernorPoints()~=Game:GetProperty('JAC_PROXY_TOTAL_0') or gs:GetGovernorPointsSpent()~=Game:GetProperty('JAC_PROXY_SPENT_0')+1 then error('official accounting differs after 1 payments') end; local total,spent=ExposedMembers.JAC_TitleProxyAccounting(0); if total~=gs:GetGovernorPoints() or spent~=gs:GetGovernorPointsSpent() then error('GameCore cannot read official accounting') end; return 'official earned total unchanged and spent increased by 1'

local gs=Players[0]:GetGovernors(); if gs:GetGovernorPoints()~=Game:GetProperty('JAC_PROXY_TOTAL_0') or gs:GetGovernorPointsSpent()~=Game:GetProperty('JAC_PROXY_SPENT_0')+1 then error('official accounting differs after 1 payments') end; local total,spent=ExposedMembers.JAC_TitleProxyAccounting(0); if total~=gs:GetGovernorPoints() or spent~=gs:GetGovernorPointsSpent() then error('GameCore cannot read official accounting') end; return 'official earned total unchanged and spent increased by 1'

local gs=Players[0]:GetGovernors(); local d=GameInfo.Governors['GOVERNOR_JAC_TITLE_PROXY']; local promotion=GameInfo.GovernorPromotions['GOVERNOR_PROMOTION_JAC_TITLE_PROXY_1']; if not gs:CanPromoteGovernor(d.Hash) then error('official payment promotion denied') end; UI.RequestPlayerOperation(0,PlayerOperations.PROMOTE_GOVERNOR,{[PlayerOperations.PARAM_GOVERNOR_TYPE]=d.Index,[PlayerOperations.PARAM_GOVERNOR_PROMOTION_TYPE]=promotion.Index}); return 'requested payment promotion 1'
